name: PHILLIPS 菲利普 SACHEM 24-speed
why_interesting: The photographed gradient-green bike matches the current SACHEM 24-speed carbon road build, including its carbon cockpit and hydraulic discs.

facts.complete_weight_basis: Current regional-retailer claim for the 2025 SACHEM family; size, pedal basis and weighing method are not stated and the retailer allows production variation
facts.frame_weight_basis: Approximate retailer claim for the SACHEM carbon frame; size, hardware and paint basis are not stated
facts.drivetrain: Mechanical 2×12 (24-speed); current retailer specification lists ShunTai or SENSAH shifting, a SENICX crank and Rihui 12-speed cassette without fixed part numbers
facts.brakes: ShunTai full-hydraulic disc brakes on the 24-speed top configuration
facts.frame_material: Carbon frame, carbon aero fork and carbon aero seatpost; the 24-speed configuration also uses a carbon integrated cockpit
facts.tires: CST 700×28C stock tires; this is not a published maximum-clearance value
facts.cockpit: Full-carbon integrated aero cockpit on the 24-speed top configuration

missing: Maximum tire clearance and complete geometry
Fixed shift-component part numbers, exact selected SKU/complete BOM, China warranty applicability and final checkout conditions
source_note: The retained gradient-green PHILLIPS card, SACHEM down-tube marking, current JD gradient-green/24-speed options and regional listings establish SACHEM identity. The retailer's 8.5 kg figure remains a claim with unspecified size and weighing basis. Stock 700×28C tires are not converted into a maximum-clearance claim. The official company profile confirms PHILLIPS / 菲利普 and 浙江菲利普车业有限公司; it does not supply the SACHEM specification.
